meta.name: investor-materials
meta.description: Create and update pitch decks, one-pagers, investor memos, accelerator applications, financial models, and fundraising materials. Use when the user needs investor-facing documents, projections, use-of-funds tables, milestone plans, or materials that must stay internally consistent across multiple fundraising assets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和更新投资人所需的各类融资材料
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在为创业项目准备融资材料
copy.tagline_en: Create and update investor-facing fundraising materials
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing fundraising materials for your startup

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你创建和更新融资材料，如演示文稿、一页纸、投资者备忘录、财务模型等。它会确保所有材料中的数字和事实保持一致，并检查逻辑漏洞。
howto.when: 当你需要制作或修改面向投资者的文档，例如演示文稿、财务模型、加速器申请等，且要求多份材料数据一致时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份种子轮融资的演示文稿，包含市场分析和资金用途。
say.note: Claude 会按推荐流程生成演示文稿，并确保数据一致。

say.text: 更新财务模型，加入熊市、基准和牛市三种情景。
say.note: Claude 会调整财务模型，包含敏感性分析。

say.text: 检查这些融资材料中的数字是否一致。
say.note: Claude 会核对所有数字与事实来源。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and update investor-facing materials such as pitch decks, one-pagers, investor memos, and financial models. It ensures all documents are consistent and checks for logical errors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create or revise investor-facing documents like pitch decks, financial models, or accelerator applications, and require consistency across multiple materials.

say_en.text: Create a pitch deck for a seed round, including market analysis and use of funds.
Update the financial model with bear, base, and bull cases.
say_en.note: Claude will adjust the model including sensitivity analysis.

say_en.text: Check these fundraising materials for number consistency.
say_en.note: Claude will cross-check all numbers against the source of truth.
